[{"id":36751145,"name":"Sola","trackName":"Sola","artistName":"Nina Cobham","albumName":"Sola - Single","duration":261.0,"instrumental":false,"hasWordSync":false,"plainLyrics":"Tengo miedo de estar sola
I need to get my act together, I know
I say I’m better on my own but he’s telling me I need to grow up, let go
I tell him that I’ve got an old soul, he said I’m there before my time
I’m asking what all of the rush is for, but i don’t want to wait in line
Good things take time
I’m running out of reasons to start up a conversation with you
usually, I’d be the first to run to your defence but this time I cant even come up with an excuse
Tengo que vivir un día a la vez
Poco a poco
Otherwise I lose my head and I start doubting Everything that I believe in
Believe me
Tengo miedo de estar sola
I need to get my act together, I know
I say I’m better on my own but, he’s telling me I need to grow up, let go
I tell him that I’ve got an old soul, he said I’m there before my time
I’m asking what all of the rush is for (no rush, no rush)
but i don’t want to wait in line (I don’t want to wait)
Good things take time.
I know good things take time, that’s why I’m willing
Gazing at the ceiling, play my intuition
For the fourth or fifth time, picture the scene
Who knows if we’ll just throw this away
Belled your phone, half four, you bell me back like half six
Whats with that?
You sent me that unsure emoji back
I thought we were way past that
Highlights and flashbacks
You say I’m misleading but you start up in your feelings
I only say I don’t do feelings ‘cause you’re not ready to hear them and I’m not ready to feel them just yet
I’d just rather not confront them because then they bring us problems and they’re always in the back of my head
See all these problems that you talking, I don’t see what you be clocking
Things I do that get you all upset
I like to think we have a future, but you tell me over and over
If I want you, come with more respect
I only say I don’t do feelings ‘cause you’re not ready to hear them and I’m not ready to feel them just yet
(solo quiero lo mismo que tu)
(how do you know? how do you know?)
I just want the same things as you
(solo quiero lo mismo que tu)
I just want the same things as you, you, you
you, you, you
The same things as you","syncedLyrics":null,"lyricsfile":"version: '1.0'

plain: |-
  Tengo miedo de estar sola
  I need to get my act together, I know
  I say I’m better on my own but he’s telling me I need to grow up, let go

  I’m asking what all of the rush is for, but i don’t want to wait in line
  Good things take time
  I’m running out of reasons to start up a conversation with you
  usually, I’d be the first to run to your defence but this time I cant even come up with an excuse
  Tengo que vivir un día a la vez
  Poco a poco
  Otherwise I lose my head and I start doubting Everything that I believe in
  Believe me
  Tengo miedo de estar sola
  I need to get my act together, I know
  I say I’m better on my own but, he’s telling me I need to grow up, let go
  I tell him that I’ve got an old soul, he said I’m there before my time
  I’m asking what all of the rush is for (no rush, no rush)
  but i don’t want to wait in line (I don’t want to wait)
  Good things take time.
  I know good things take time, that’s why I’m willing
  Gazing at the ceiling, play my intuition
  For the fourth or fifth time, picture the scene
  Who knows if we’ll just throw this away
  Belled your phone, half four, you bell me back like half six
  Whats with that?
  You sent me that unsure emoji back
  I thought we were way past that
  Highlights and flashbacks
  You say I’m misleading but you start up in your feelings
  I only say I don’t do feelings ‘cause you’re not ready to hear them and I’m not ready to feel them just yet
  I’d just rather not confront them because then they bring us problems and they’re always in the back of my head
  See all these problems that you talking, I don’t see what you be clocking
  Things I do that get you all upset
  I like to think we have a future, but you tell me over and over
  If I want you, come with more respect
  I only say I don’t do feelings ‘cause you’re not ready to hear them and I’m not ready to feel them just yet
  (solo quiero lo mismo que tu)
  (how do you know? how do you know?)
  I just want the same things as you
  (solo quiero lo mismo que tu)
  I just want the same things as you, you, you
  you, you, you
  The same things as you
